cancMetaDescrizione: Request deletion of your Kidville account from the web, without signing in to the app.
cancIntro: From this page you can request the deletion of your Kidville account, even without signing in to the app or reinstalling it.
cancInviato: If the address is linked to a Kidville account, you will receive an email with a link to confirm the request. Please also check your spam folder.
cancErrore: Something went wrong. Please try again in a few minutes.
cancConfermaIntro: Press the button to confirm the deletion request for your Kidville account. The request will be handled by the school office, which will anonymise your personal data.
cancConfermaOk: Request registered. The school office will handle it and irreversibly anonymise your personal data. Tax documents are kept as required by law.
cancConfermaErrore: We could not register the request. The link may have expired or already been used: go back to the deletion page and request a new one.
cancConfermaLinkNonValido: Invalid or incomplete link. Go back to the deletion page and request a new link.
candMetaDescrizione: Send your application to teach at the Kidville schools.
candSottotitolo: Send your application as a teacher
candSediErroreCorpo: Without the list of locations we can’t file your application at the right one, so the form does not start from here. Check your connection and try again; if the error continues, try again in a few minutes.
candSediVuoteTitolo: No location is accepting online applications
candSediVuoteCorpo: The list of locations did arrive, but right now it contains no location accepting applications from this form. We do not start it, so that you don’t fill everything in with nowhere to file it: please write to the school office, or try again later.
candSedeSub: Choose the location you want to apply to
candDatiSub: How we can get back to you
candRiepilogoSedeDalLink: Location set by the link you opened the form with
candRiepilogoFasce: Age groups you are applying for
candContestoDirezione: Your application goes to the school management of the location you chose: that location reviews it.
candContestoDirezioneDalLink: Your application goes to the school management of the location set by the link you opened the form with: that location reviews it.
candContestoTempi: There is no stated reply deadline: the school management gets back to you once the review is done. In the meantime your application stays on file.
candContestoCredenziali: No account is needed: if your application is accepted, your login credentials arrive by email at the address you entered here. Check that it is correct before submitting.
candRiepilogoControllaEmail: Check that the email address above is spelled correctly: it is the only way the school management can reply to you.
candRiepilogoNota: Press “Submit application” to send your details to the school management. No account is needed: if your application is accepted, your credentials will follow.
candRitornoInterrottoTitolo: Something is missing before the summary
candRitornoInterrottoCorpo: Your change left the step “{passo}” without a required field: taking you straight back to the summary would skip this check, and the summary would say everything is fine. Fill in what is missing below and continue: from here you move one step at a time.
candErroreInvioCorpo: Something went wrong while submitting. Check your details and try again.
candErroreInvioDatiSalvi: The details you entered are still here: nothing to fill in again, just press “Submit application” once more.
candSedeRifiutataCorpo: The location set by the link you opened the form with is not accepting applications: the link may be an old one.
candSedeRifiutataCorpoScelta: The location you had chosen is not accepting applications: it may have been switched off while you were filling in the form.
candSedeRifiutataNota: The details you entered are still here: nothing to fill in again. Choose the location above and carry on to the summary.
candSedeRifiutataNotaAttesa: The details you entered are still here and there is nothing to fill in again: your application was NOT sent. As soon as the list of locations above is available again, choose the location and try again.
candInviataCorpo: Your application has been received: the school management will review it and get back to you. If it is accepted, you will receive your login credentials by email.
candEscaEtichetta: Do not fill in this field
moduloAccessoCorpo: This form is only available to registered users. Log in to fill it out.
wizardAdultoInfo: At least one adult is required. If you are already the parent of an enrolled child, use the same tax code: the new child will be automatically linked to your profile.
wizardErroreInvio: An error occurred while submitting. Check your details and try again.
wizardErroreInvioDatiSalvi: The details you entered are still here: nothing to fill in again, just press “Submit request” once more.
wizardInviataCorpo: Your enrollment request has been received. The office will review it and contact you with your login credentials.
wizardRiepilogoConteggio: You are enrolling <n>{bambini}</n> {bambini, plural, one {child} other {children}} with <n>{adulti}</n> {adulti, plural, one {adult} other {adults}} as reference contacts.
wizardRiepilogoNota: Press Submit request to send your details to the office. You will receive confirmation and login credentials after review.
wizardSediErroreCorpo: Without the list of locations we can’t file the enrollment at the right one, so the form does not start from here. Check your connection and try again; if the error continues, try again in a few minutes.
wizardSediVuoteTitolo: No location is accepting online enrollments
wizardSediVuoteCorpo: The list of locations did arrive, but right now it contains no location accepting applications from this form. We do not start it, so that you don’t fill in your child’s details with nowhere to file them: please contact the school office, or try again later.
wizardSedeSub: Choose the location where you want to enroll your child
